title: Payout account and settlements
caption: PF-63, PF-64. Owners edit, finance reads; needs FEATURE_SETTLEMENTS.

steps.title: Add a payout account
steps.body: Holder, bank country, currency, IBAN `NO9386011117947` with BIC `DNBANOKK` (the IBAN registry's example), **Save the payout account**.
steps.expect: Step-up dialog "Confirm it is you", then the masked view "•••• 7947" and "Pending review".

steps.title: Check storage
steps.body: `select status, last4, scheme from platform.tenant_payout_accounts where tenant_id='<id>';`

steps.title: Wrong IBAN
steps.body: Change one digit of the IBAN.
steps.expect: Checksum error at the field, no call; the number is never echoed back.

steps.title: Settlements
steps.body: Open the list and a statement; **Download the lines as CSV**.
steps.expect: Only approved, paid and carried-forward statements; file `velexis-statement-<yyyy-mm>-<CUR>.csv`; drafts answer 404.
